violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child was left unsupervised.

violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.41(j)
violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection floors/walls ceilings were observed Not maintained; in disrepair or covered in a toxic finish.

violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(c)(1)
violation_types.typical_finding: Staff and volunteers obtain documentation showing immunization with 2 doses measles/mumps, 1 dose rubella, 2 doses varicella and 1 dose Tdap. Medical exemptions only. History of measles, mumps or rubella shall Not replace MMR vaccine except in presence of MMR varicella antibodies.

violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that a child was left unattended, the caregiver was not at a physical proximity that allowed visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.33(b)
violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection it was determined that child care service allows staff to perform their duties that are Not healthy or are incapable of carrying out their duties. Staff medical clearances are Not maintained by child care service.

violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.

violation_types.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.

violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.

violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.

violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was pending 10 hours of annual training hours.    One out of four employees was pending 6 hours in business.

violation_types.title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: CPSC form was not available for review.

violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.37(b)(1)
violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection it was determined that child care service failed to ensure staff received required training within time frames and/or failed to maintain training records.

violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

violation_types.title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: The classroom walls and window sills had pealing paint. In the Pre-K room one of the walls is stained and dirty. The peeling paint is in the reach of children. The floors in tile floors in the infant rooms are stained and dirty. This is not safe for the children to crawl on.

violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.

violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: One child is missing a health statement.

violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

violation_types.title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: There were no annual training hours available for viewing.

violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.

violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))
violation_types.typical_finding: The promotion of Physical Activity was not available for review in the Operational Policies.

violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: One child in care did not have an immunization record available for review.

violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.25(a)(2)(B)
violation_types.typical_finding: Enrolled children 6 months to 59 months have Not received FDA approved annual influenza immunization by December 31 of the year

violation_types.title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection an eight month infant was observed with a blanket inside the crib.   This was corrected at inspection.

violation_types.title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.

violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.

violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))
violation_types.typical_finding: Training hours for the caregivers were not available for review.

violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: The infants did not have infant feeding instructions available for review.

violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.

violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §47.49(a)
violation_types.typical_finding: At time of inspection child care service facility observed Not maintained or in disrepair. Dry sweeping observed in areas occupied by children.

violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was no admission information available for children in care.

violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, a child was disciplined by pinching their ear, which resulted in bruising.

violation_types.title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)
violation_types.typical_finding: One child's medication was expired.

violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))
violation_types.typical_finding: The proper depth of loose fill is not being maintained on the playground.

violation_types.title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parent in a timely manner of a situation involving their child.

violation_types.title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))
violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were sending and receiving personal text messages while caring for children.

violation_types.title: NYC Health Code §43.11(b)
violation_types.typical_finding: School-based child care staff observed caring for children while unhealthy. Staff medical certificate of fitness Not provided.

violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

violation_types.title: Critical Injury - Contact Parent (26 TAC §746.3607(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation failed to notify the parents of children who required medical attention. The incident occurred at 9:00 am, and the parents found out about the incident when they picked up their children.

violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Withholding Active Play (26 TAC §744.2105(8))
violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were overheard telling children they would "owe them 5 minutes" for not following directions or stay inside instead of going outside during their playground time  for continuing to roll around the room on the rolling chairs after being asked to stop.

violation_types.title: Electronic Smoke-Detection System Tested (26 TAC §747.5117)
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not conduct their monthly electronic smoke detection system for the year 2023.

violation_types.title: Additional Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free from Other Activities Not Directly Involving Teaching, Care and Supervision (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(6))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver was washing dishes when the child climbed and fell from the coffee table resulting in injury.

violation_types.title: Required documentation for Vision and Hearing Screening Requirement (26 TAC §747.633(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: Hearing and vision statements were not available to review for 5 children enrolled in care over the age of four.

violation_types.title: Fire- Extinguishing System (26 TAC §746.5301)
violation_types.typical_finding: The center did not have any fire extinguishers at the time of inspection because they were removed from the premises to get serviced the day before.     Note, this was corrected at inspection when several of the fire extinguishers were returned to the operation and had the service tag.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Minimum Height of 22 Inches from Top of Railing to Mattress Support at Lowest Level (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(E))
violation_types.typical_finding: A bassinet was observed at inspection as sleep equipment for a 6 month old infant. The manufacturer instructions specifies this sleep equipment is for 0-5 month olds. Additionally, a bassinet of 11.5 inches in height from the sleep surface to the top of the rail does not meet the play yard guidelines of at least 22 inches required.

violation_types.title: Exceptions for Immunization Requirements Must Meet Criteria Specified by DSHS (26 TAC §746.615(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: One child enrolled in care had an expired  immunization exemption.

violation_types.title: Special Handling Procedures for Get-Well Care - Garbage Covered (26 TAC §746.3123(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Garbage bin was observed with out a lid in one of the restrooms.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the garbage bin with out the lid from the restroom.

violation_types.title: Inspection of Sprinkler System (26 TAC §746.5309)
violation_types.typical_finding: The last fire alarm system inspection documented was for 5/3/22.  A current fire alarm system was not available for CCR to review.

violation_types.title: Immunizations-Documentation of immunizations may be official record or photocopy that includes - Child's name and date of birth (26 TAC §746.623(2)(A))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child's file was review and the immunizations in file was a picture and not a copy or the original.

violation_types.title: Documentation of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §744.3655)
violation_types.typical_finding: Proof of gas leak test needed.

violation_types.title: Field Trips-Food Allergy Emergency Plan and Allergy Medications (26 TAC §744.2301(5))
violation_types.typical_finding: One child attending field trip with a diagnosed food allergy on enrollment form did not have a food allergy emergency plan.     One child with a diagnosed food allergy did not have medication required on food allergy emergency plan.

violation_types.title: Care Requirements 5 or More Hours - Provide Indoor and Outdoor Active Play (26 TAC §744.2002(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is offering summer care from 9am-3pm and does not have an outdoor area.

violation_types.title: If a subject of background check at your operation is under investigation for abuse or neglect you must notify Licensing immediately (26 TAC §745.673)
violation_types.typical_finding: The provider was aware of an individual with a background check listed under the operation that is not a household member that has/had an open Child Protective Services case and did not report it in a timely manner.

violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Safe Sleeping Deficiency (26 TAC §746.309(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Operation did not submit Safe Sleep Parent Notification on the due date 5.29.26.

violation_types.title: Operation and Program Director Annual Training-more than five years, management, supervision, leadership (26 TAC §744.1311(e)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the records review the directors file was missing the clock hours in managment.

violation_types.title: Caring for Children Above or Below Ground Level - Follow any restrictions (26 TAC §746.4217(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based upon the information obtained during the investigation, sufficient evidence was available to support the restrictions issued by the Fire Marshal had not been followed by allowing children under 2-years old to be cared for above ground level in the months of March and April 2024.  CORRECTED - There were no children under 2-years-old being cared for in May 2024.  Procedures have been put in place to ensure children who have not turned 2-years old will not be allowed upstairs.

violation_types.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Parent Choice (26 TAC §746.3309(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a written agreement in regard to the parent providing snacks for their child while in care.

violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Drinking Water Available and Served (26 TAC §747.3101(f)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The children were observed having morning outside time but did not have drinking water available to them while outside.

violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor and Active Play (26 TAC §747.2104(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: The written activity plan only listed one daily opportunity for outdoor play.

violation_types.title: Activities for Toddlers - Provide Large Muscle Development (26 TAC §746.2507(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined during the investigation that the victim was playing on equipment that is not age appropriate for a twenty-three-month-old. The playground equipment was designed for older children and presented an injury risk to the victim.

violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Homework (26 TAC §744.2007(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated during an unannounced monitoring inspection and found to be deficient when school aged children were observed using cell phones in the class for activities unrelated to homework or educational activities.

violation_types.title: Care Requirements for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Individual Attention (26 TAC §746.2601(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The investigation found that a caregiver was redirecting a child and the child tripped, and the caregiver did not console the child afterwards.

violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Antiseptic solution or wipes (26 TAC §744.2753(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have antiseptic wipes or solution in the first aid kit or the guide to the first aid kit.

violation_types.title: Toddler Daily Report (26 TAC §746.2509)
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not inform the parent of a toddler that the child had an ongoing diaper rash.

violation_types.title: Activities for School-age - Provides Thinking Skills and Sensory Development (26 TAC §746.2707(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: In the school-age classroom, a wide variety of toys that meet age-appropriate expectations was observed.

violation_types.title: Protective Barriers Around Porches or Platforms (26 TAC §747.4401(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: The patio has about a 3 foot drop on the two sides and about 15 stairs in front. The provider is going to create a protective barrier around the patio, but it was not complete at the time of inspection.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entrapment Openings (26 TAC §747.4401(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The slide on the play scape is coming apart and broken.

violation_types.title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §744.3611(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was no smoke detectors in the classrooms. Note: corrected during inspection.

violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §747.305(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: It was found that the operation did not notify a parent of a less serious at drop off.

violation_types.title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior (26 TAC §747.2703(4)(C))
violation_types.typical_finding: One child in care was in time out for more than 15 minutes during inspection.

violation_types.title: Documentation for Directors - Verification of Meeting Educational Requirements (26 TAC §746.1039(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 3 staff files evaluated did not contain documentation of meeting educational requirements.

violation_types.title: Illness Preventing Care - Symptoms of Possible Severe Illness (26 TAC §746.3601(3)(E))
violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation it was found that a child was not sent home when the child had symptoms of a possible severe illness. There was a concern for the child's breathing and the child was not sent home.

violation_types.title: Additional Requirements For Outdoor Activity Space Not Connected To Center - Other Conditions Specified (26 TAC §746.4313(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: A follow-up inspection was conducted and compliance was not met. This deficiency is being recited.  Additional conditions were implemented for the operation to follow a playground safety and transition plan which has not been maintained. Securing both exit gates, maintenance of the back alley, and number of caregivers to maintain proper supervision have not been practiced and conducted regularly.

violation_types.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §747.2809(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: Child was observed napping on a cot between the bed and the closet,  having very little space to move.

violation_types.title: Requirements for Stacking Wall Cribs - Used Only for Infant that Cannot Stand or Can Stand Without Hitting Head (26 TAC §746.2413(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection an infant was observed in the bottom of a stacking crib standing with their head touching the bottom of the top crib.

violation_types.title: Requirements for Tire Swings - Not Suspended from Composite Structure (26 TAC §747.4505(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Tire swing was observed connected to the composite structure.

violation_types.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows Responsibilities (26 TAC §744.1013(b)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver who was left in charge during the site director's absence was not aware of responsibilities as the designated person in charge.

violation_types.title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers-Local Licensing Office Phone Number (26 TAC §744.405(a)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: The telephone number and address of the local Child Care Regulation office is not on the list of the required  telephone numbers.

violation_types.title: HRC42.052(f) - To remain listed or registered, home must comply with the department's applicable rules and standards (26 TAC §HRC42.052(f) - To remain listed or regis)
violation_types.code: HRC42.052(f) - To remain listed or regis
violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder was observed caring for one unrelated child 3 months old during the follow-up inspection.

violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Waterproof, disposable gloves (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit did not have disposable gloves during the inspection.

violation_types.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Interest Centers Used Independently (26 TAC §746.2605(1)(B))
violation_types.typical_finding: A total of eight classroom were observed. Four out of eight classroom needs a storage bin, toys accessories and equipment and other children desk and tables.

violation_types.title: No Exploding/Shooting Toys or Equipment (26 TAC §746.3709)
violation_types.typical_finding: During outdoor water activity, there was a child playing with a water gun. There were other children squirting each other with a crayon water wand gun.

violation_types.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §747.701(5))
violation_types.typical_finding: An Incident report was not completed regarding for an incident that placed a child at risk when the child exited the facility without being supervised.

violation_types.title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Length (26 TAC §744.1331(b)(6))
violation_types.typical_finding: One out of eight caregiver training reviewed is missing the training length on the certificate.

violation_types.title: Special Diets - No Nutrient Concentrates or Supplements (26 TAC §746.3311(d))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained from the DFPS Investigation, there is enough evidence to show that the operation did not have written instructions from a healthcare professional for a child with a special diet due to a disability.

violation_types.title: AP Additional Caregiver Responsibilities - Never Exceed  Capacity of 12 Children (26 TAC §742.307(3)(B))
violation_types.typical_finding: There were seven unrelated children in care.

violation_types.title: Documented annual training - Specific to water safety (26 TAC §746.1325(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: All caregivers and director need water safety training.

violation_types.title: Electric or Battery Operated CO Detection System- Installed in Compliance with State or Local Fire Marshal's Instructions (26 TAC §747.5335(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Carbon monoxide dectector was not observed in the home.

violation_types.title: Release of Children (26 TAC §747.3901(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child was released by the operation's staff, to an unauthorized person.

violation_types.title: Recommend or impose an enforcement action (26 TAC §745.8605)
violation_types.typical_finding: You supplied false information or made false statements during the application process.

violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Center & Playground Free of Unfamiliar Animals (26 TAC §746.3905(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was an animal unfamiliar to the caregivers not removed from the playground before children could interact with it.

violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Bucket Swings - on Sides (26 TAC §746.4811(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: Bucket swings in the toddler playground were found not having the 6 feet of use zone on the side of the adjacent swing and the fence.   *Swing was removed immediately.

violation_types.typical_finding: The operation failed to follow their Illness and Exclusion policy for children with a fever and allowed a child to remain in care.

violation_types.title: Change of ownership (26 TAC §745.437)
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on a search of the Secretary of State website the operations LLC is not currently active.

violation_types.title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §744.201(7))

violation_types.title: Plan to Handle Transportation Emergencies (26 TAC §744.3819)

violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Wash Napkins, Bibs and Tablecloths (26 TAC §746.3317(3))

violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Regular Meals and Snacks (26 TAC §746.2419(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed in part of a report and found to be deficient. An infant was not fed the regular meals provided by the parent.

violation_types.typical_finding: 1 child under 4'9" was not transported in a booster seat.

violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - on Sides (26 TAC §747.4607(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: One outdoor swing did not have the required amount of use zone space around it.  The provider removed the swing during the inspection and brought this into compliance.

violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a safety plan for a field trip taken by foot 1 hour and 32 minutes away from the operation with a child.

violation_types.typical_finding: A child was placed in a crib that did not have a safely secured drop down gate, causing the child to fall out.

violation_types.title: Required Liability Insurance (26 TAC §745.249)

violation_types.typical_finding: The high chairs in the infant room were rinsed with water but were not sanitized with a sanitizing product before use.

violation_types.typical_finding: I observed a one child age 4 years old in the bathroom alone with the door closed without an adult present.

violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found to be deficient in one classroom.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored So Do Not Hold Water (26 TAC §746.5013(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: Two inflatable pools were on the school age playground with water.

violation_types.typical_finding: Per caregiver, infant hasn't been outside since the winter cold weather.

violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has a pool and the pool pump is accessible to children in the outdoor play area.

NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the safety gate from the doorway and put it away in a storage room.

NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the cleaning supplies from the food preparation area and stored them in an area inaccessible to the children.

violation_types.typical_finding: Children are not going outside due to weather conditions and are staying at the tables during hours of the program. CI: The site director let the children decided which physical activity they should play to get them moving around. The children ended up playing Simon Says.

violation_types.typical_finding: The applicant do not have their high school diploma at the time of the application inspection.

violation_types.typical_finding: Child 3 years old fell from a restrictive play equipment and required medical attention.

violation_types.typical_finding: The material of the swing seat may not meet current requirements.

violation_types.title: Indoor Space Requirement - 30 Square Feet per Child (26 TAC §747.4001)
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have enough indoor space for 11 children.

violation_types.title: Length of Naptime (26 TAC §747.2803)
violation_types.typical_finding: Two children who arrived at 6am were allowed to nap for more that 3 hours.

violation_types.title: Nighttime Requirements - Cot, Bed or Mattress for 18 mos or older (26 TAC §746.3207(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child was observed asleep on the floor during nighttime hours of operation.     NOTE: This was corrected during inspection. Child was provided with a sleeping mat.

violation_types.title: Documented annual training - Employee prior to accompanying a child to a swimming pool (26 TAC §744.1318(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Four employees who accompany children to pools away from the operation did not have water safety training.

violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment - Multiple Occupancy Swings (26 TAC §744.3105(a)(5))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation playground contains prohibited equipment: the Airplane Teeter Totter.

violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Caregiver-initiated Activities (26 TAC §747.2104(a)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver is not developing a written caregiver-initiated activity plan.

violation_types.title: Handwashing Sink Used Safely and Independently (26 TAC §747.4203(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: Primary caregiver blocks children into one room and the space is blocked by a gate, children are not able to safely and independently walk to use hand washing sink.

violation_types.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED- Not in Charge of Group (26 TAC §744.1107(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver under the age of 18 years old was in charge of a group of children.

violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion of Children (26 TAC §744.501(8))
violation_types.typical_finding: Operational Policies did not state their policy for suspension and expulsion of children.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment  - Arranged for Supervision (26 TAC §747.4401(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The skirting under the deck allows for children to go underneath. A barrier needs to be installed.

violation_types.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School (26 TAC §744.1107(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A high school student under the age of 18 was counted in ratio but is not currently enrolled or completed a child care related care program through the Texas Education Agency. Additionally this person had the sole responsibility for a group of children at one point during inspection.

violation_types.title: Site Director Qualifications -  Age - 21 if caring for Pre-K age, 18 if age 5 and up (26 TAC §744.1017(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: Operation is currently with no site director.

violation_types.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available (26 TAC §747.2405(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have activities for children to engage in.

violation_types.title: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 747.307 within 5 Days (26 TAC §747.309(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation notified all parents of a safe sleep deficiency, but failed to notify all parents with children enrolled of the safe sleep deficiency within the required time frame of 5 days.     Note: This was corrected during the inspection when the the permit holder signed a written statement that she understands all safe sleep deficiencies require that all parents be notified within 5 days of receiving the deficiency.

violation_types.title: Director Responsibilities - Submit and Follow Written Plan of Responsibilities (26 TAC §744.1005(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A plan for assignment of responsibilities was not available for review.

violation_types.title: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines - Except if Less Than 4 Feet, 12 Inches or Less Above Resilient Material (26 TAC §744.3105(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found  non-compliant.    It was discovered that a child was on a trampoline that was more than 4 feet in diameter and more than 12 inches off the ground.

violation_types.title: Maximum Height - 5 Yrs and Older (26 TAC §744.3109(b)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Children were playing on rock wall play equipment that was more than 7 feet tall. This was corrected when the children stopped playing on the rock wall.

violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment- If Above Floor Level Must Use Safety Mechanism (26 TAC §747.3303(c)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver is using a shelf accessible to children for diaper changing. There are no observed safety mechanisms in place such as raised sides.

violation_types.title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §747.2805(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: One child was sleeping on a nap time mat  with their head covered by their blanket. This was corrected when the caregiver uncovered their head.

violation_types.title: Special Diets - Written Approval from Health Care Professional or Dietician if not Related to Disability (26 TAC §746.3311(a)(1)(B))
violation_types.typical_finding: When reviewing children's files, the children with food intolerances did not have documentation from health care provider or dietician.

violation_types.title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Personnel or Hospitalization (26 TAC §747.305(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was an accidental injury where a toddler climbed onto a small table and then fell onto the ground. The caregiver reported that the child appeared to be uninjured and completed an incident report but did not immediately contact and notify the parent. The parent later sought medical treatment for the child.

violation_types.title: Swimming Pools - Chemicals and Pumps Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.5001(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: Children have direct access to the chemical pump in the pool area due to gate being broken.

violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Single Use Items if Cannot Sanitize (26 TAC §746.3317(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Food service equipment, such as bowls, utensils and bottles, are not being sanitized.  Noted, that these items are being cleaned with dish soap and water.

violation_types.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Enough Available (26 TAC §747.2505(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have age-appropriate activities for the children to engage in.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Minimum Height of 22 Inches from Top of Railing to Mattress Support at Lowest Level (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(E))
violation_types.typical_finding: The two play pens used as the sleeping areas for two infants in care was raised and did not meet the 22 inch requirement. This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver lowered the surface.

violation_types.title: All Adult Passengers Wear Safety Belts (26 TAC §746.5609(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was determined caregivers have not worn seat belts as required when transporting children in care.

violation_types.title: Orientation Required for Caregivers-Required Operational Policies (26 TAC §747.1301(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The pre-service training for the applicatant was not available for review during the application inspection.

violation_types.title: Maximum Height - Under Age 5 (26 TAC §744.3109(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The maximum height of the highest designated play surface on a climbing structure used by 4 year old children is over 5 feet high.

violation_types.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority (26 TAC §744.1013(b)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection the caregiver left in charge was not able to produce records requested by the licensing inspector.

violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §744.3203)
violation_types.typical_finding: It was found during the inspection the operation had a Jungle gym and air plane equipment you climb and there was not 6 feet of cleared space around the primeter of the equipment and use zones for the equipment were overlapping.

violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Second Serving (26 TAC §744.2401(e))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child requested a second serving of food and was denied.

violation_types.title: Licensing must have access to records (26 TAC §745.8417)
violation_types.typical_finding: Operation did not have files available as apart of the investigation.

violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Withholding Active Play (26 TAC §747.2705(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child was observed being restricted from active play for an extended period of time.

violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Wading Activities (26 TAC §747.2001(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver was not compliance with ratio during wading activities.

violation_types.title: Illness Preventing Care - Communicable Disease (26 TAC §746.3601(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: During this investigation, it was determined the operation allowed a child to return to school without a doctor's note after being notified by the child's parent that the child had two communicable diseases (pink eye and hand, foot, and mouth) during different time frames.    Note: The child is no longer enrolled at the operation. The de-enrollment date was on 11/28/2022.

violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness Plan-Continuity of Care until Children Released (26 TAC §744.3553(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's emergency preparedness plan did not contain information on how the operation will ensure the children are supervised and care will be continued at the relocation area if they can not return to the operation due to an evacuation.

violation_types.title: Share Outdoor Activity Space With Written Plan (26 TAC §744.2963(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: The program does not have a written plan for the shared outside space for the licensed program and the exempt program.

violation_types.title: Requirements for Swings - Seats of Durable, Lightweight, Rubber or Plastic (26 TAC §746.4701(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: A swing was observed to have a tire for its seat which is not a lightweight material.

violation_types.title: Maintain copy of court order in child's file (26 TAC §746.4101(b)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a copy of a court order in a child's file.

violation_types.title: HRC42.048(e) - Permit issued is not transferable - Revoked if change of owner or location (26 TAC §HRC42.048(e) - Permit issued is not tran)
violation_types.code: HRC42.048(e) - Permit issued is not tran
violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder failed to meet all requirements related to the new location and is operating at the new location without being permitted. Per HRC42.048(e)(3)(2). A licensed child-care facility that changes location:  (2)  may not operate at the new location unless the commission approves the new location after the licensed child-care facility meets all requirements related to the new location.

violation_types.title: Notify Parents in Policy if Not Administering Medication (26 TAC §746.3811)
violation_types.typical_finding: One Epi-Pen expired in 10/2022.

violation_types.title: Documentation of Training Requirements-Signed and Dated Statement of Orientation (26 TAC §747.1327(d))
violation_types.typical_finding: Two assistant caregivers did not have a signed orientation statement.

violation_types.title: Orientation-Operational Policies (26 TAC §744.1303(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Orientation for employees to the operation's policies were missing and not on file.

violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System -  12 Months Through 3 Years; More Than 20 Pounds (26 TAC §746.5607(d)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, a three year old was transported without the proper front facing child safety seat.

violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Regular Meals and Snacks (26 TAC §744.2401(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined that a child enrolled in the operation did not receive a scheduled lunch meal during a break camp day, despite being signed up for the lunch package.

violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System-8 through 12 years, less than 4 feet 9 inches in height; cannot be properly secured by vehicle belt (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(6)(A))
violation_types.typical_finding: Children ages eight through twelve years of age who are  less than 4 feet, 9  inches in height are riding in the operations van/ general purpose vehicle without booster seats.

violation_types.title: Immunization Exception or Exemption on File and Verified (26 TAC §744.613(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: There were 11 children in care and the operation only had 5 children's records available for review and stated that they are waiting on immunizations from 6 children and did not have records avalaible for them.

violation_types.title: Crib Mattress Cover - Snug-Fitting and Thin (26 TAC §747.2315(c)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a play pen with a thin paper lining under their head.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Secure Supports (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(D))
violation_types.typical_finding: One play yard had a whole in the mesh siding.    Note: The play yards were not being used and were removed from the classroom.

violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio -  2 Caregivers With 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1705)
violation_types.typical_finding: One infant classroom had two caregivers caring for eleven infants.  The classroom moved four infants during the inspection into a seperate classroom with another caregiver.

violation_types.title: Washing Hands After Using Gloves (26 TAC §746.3425(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver in the 2 year old classroom was changing diapers and cleaning faces and did not wash her hands in between changing gloves. Note: The caregiver washed her hands during the inspection.

violation_types.title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §747.1015)
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has a diploma/GED from outside the Untied States that is not translated to English.

violation_types.title: Block certification training include hours and topics (26 TAC §744.1321(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: 2 block training staff certificates reviewed did not specify the time spent for each topic of training.

violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Meal and Snack Schedule (26 TAC §746.3303)
violation_types.typical_finding: Due to the food program requirements, there needs to be many changes to the snack calendar to replace grain based desserts and desserts to food with less added sugar more whole grains. Foods needing tobe replaced would be: apple, cinnimon straws, taco puffs, veggie straws, pirates booty, vanilla wafers, nutrigrain bars.

violation_types.title: Pre-service Training- Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.1305(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's staff did not have access to employee pre-service or training files for child care regulations to review.

violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers -Intervene to ensure each child's safety (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(5))
violation_types.typical_finding: It was found that the primary caregiver failed to intervene on several occasions causing a child to receive several less serious injuries on different occasions.

violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Tire Swings - All Directions (26 TAC §746.4809(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: One tire swing structure that did not have the required use zone. The operation will not use this structure until the required use zone can be obtained.

violation_types.title: Licensing must be allowed to inspect and investigate operation (26 TAC §745.8413)
violation_types.typical_finding: Operation refused to allow the investigator to interview children.

violation_types.title: Nighttime Care - Screen Time Activities Not Used in Bed/Before Bedtime (26 TAC §746.3209(b)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Children were already having their bed time when I came into the operation however the Television was still on.

violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §747.2319(7))
violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver was observed washing her hands a child's hands after diapering in the kitchen sink, which was also used to clean bottles.

violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Children Not Allowed to Play with Unfamiliar Animals (26 TAC §746.3905(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. It was determined during the investigation that children were interacting and playing with a monkey that was brought to the operation.

violation_types.title: Parental Communication - Notify Parent Immediately of Administration of an unassigned Epinephrine Auto-injector (26 TAC §746.307(b)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parents in a timely manner of the incidents regarding supervision.

violation_types.title: Toddler Out of Crib When Not Sleeping (26 TAC §746.2907(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A toddler who was not sleeping was placed in a crib as a redirection/ discipline method.

violation_types.title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect and Exploitation (26 TAC §747.207(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not report suspected abuse of a child in care. The primary caregiver noted serious concerns regarding bruises that were observed on a child in care and stated that she knew she was required to report the suspected abuse. This information was obtained through the course of the investigation.

violation_types.title: Field Trips - Notification to Parents (26 TAC §744.2303)
violation_types.typical_finding: The field trip notification did not have when they will be returning to the operation. A photo was taken and the director made the correction to the notifiation.

violation_types.title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Date (26 TAC §747.1327(b)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Training certificates provided did not have a date of completions.

violation_types.title: Activities for Toddlers - Develop Self-help Skills (26 TAC §746.2507(8))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is not giving a child who is potty trained opportunities to use a toilet while in care.

violation_types.title: Activities for Toddlers - Provide Thinking Skills and Sensory Development (26 TAC §747.2407(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have any puzzles for toddlers and early pre school children.

violation_types.title: Telephone with Listed Number (26 TAC §746.4507(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation it was found the operation does not have a main phone line for parents to contact.

violation_types.title: Orientation-Handling Emergencies (26 TAC §744.1303(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: Through the course of the investigation it was found that two caregivers present did not have orientation to the site that would have helped them better handle an incident of a child having a serious injury.

violation_types.title: Activities for Infants - Provide Small Muscle Development (26 TAC §746.2417(7))
violation_types.typical_finding: There is sufficient evidence to support that a child was playing with an object that was not age appropriate or a toy.

violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease (26 TAC §744.307(d))
violation_types.typical_finding: Parents were not informed of a case of  COVID 19.

violation_types.title: Handwashing Sinks and Toilets (26 TAC §747.4201)
violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection it was found that the toilet available for use to the children was not able to flush properly.

violation_types.title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Accommodations (26 TAC §747.2107(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection staff were unable to provide a curriculum or documentation to demonstrate that an educational or activity plan was in place for the child with special needs.

violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications for Assistant Caregiver - 18 years old (26 TAC §747.1207(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The provider does not have documentation for assistant caregiver.

violation_types.title: Definition of Use Zone (26 TAC §747.4601)
violation_types.typical_finding: Play equipment in the backyard did not meet the use zone requirements.

violation_types.title: Outdoor Activity Space Accessible By Safe Route (26 TAC §747.4113)
violation_types.typical_finding: It was observed that the route to the backyard is thru an enclosed area that served at storage room.  The following items are accessible to children when they walk through:  Hammer, Saw, various cleaning bottles, portable cooker.

violation_types.title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - Age Requirement (26 TAC §744.1105(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver was found to be 17 years of age and in high school.

violation_types.title: Follow Written Plan and Submit to Licensing Upon Request (26 TAC §744.2909(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A written plan detailing the indoor activity in the process of sharing locker rooms and family room has not been provided for review.   4/7/22--Will get updated on 4/11/22.

violation_types.title: Personnel Record Storage (26 TAC §746.907(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during a DFPS investigation, a violation was found. The operation did not have records available for two caregivers during the DFPS face-to-face visit. One caregiver's last day of employment was two months before the day of the visit per the director, but no documents were provided, and the second caregiver was present, and no file was available during the DFPS face-to-face visit. The DFPS was not able to review any records during the visit and also requested records by email, and no records were sent.

violation_types.title: Immunizations-Immunization record must include the month, day, and year the child received each vaccination (26 TAC §746.623(1)(C))
violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file did not have the updated immunization record.

violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3801(5))
violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was stored below the diaper changing table which in a location accessible to children in care.    This was corrected at inspection when the first aid kit was moved to an area inaccessible to children.

violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Meet federal standards (26 TAC §746.5607(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was a bus with Texas license plate U21401 that has 8 seats without working seat belts.

violation_types.title: Activities for Toddlers - Provide Small Muscle Development (26 TAC §746.2507(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver shared that children have not been outside in a week.

violation_types.title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §744.2803(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child was observed being released to someone who had not been identified by the operation. The operation failed to record the identity by a valid photo ID, or  license plate. The staff stood at the door during the release.

violation_types.title: HRC42.056(g) - BGC-persons cannot provide direct care/have direct access to children without all required background checks unless they meet certain criteria. (26 TAC §HRC42.056(g) - BGC-persons cannot provid)
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver at the operation did not have the correct background check to be left alone with children unsupervised or be counted in ratio.

violation_types.title: Requirements for Tire - Not Suspended from a Composite Structure (26 TAC §746.4705(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has a tire swing attached to a composite structure.

violation_types.title: Personnel Record Storage - Training Records (26 TAC §744.907(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: Training records for the site director and one caregiver were not available at inspection.

violation_types.title: Install CO Detector System- In Compliance with State or Local Fire Marshal's Instructions (26 TAC §746.5535(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was not a working carbon monoxide detector present during the operation.   A staff member installed batteries in the carbon monoxide detector during my visit.

violation_types.title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §744.2103(b)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver was observed restraining a child and pulling the child out from under a cafeteria table by both legs.

violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Adaptive Equipment and Instructions (26 TAC §744.605(12)(B)(ii))
violation_types.typical_finding: Children's files evaluated were missing the following:  - Any Adaptive Equipment provided for the child and Instructions

violation_types.title: Nighttime Care - Screen Time Activities Meet Requirements (26 TAC §746.3209(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Screen time was on during sleep time. This was corrected when the caregiver in charge turned the Television off.

violation_types.title: School-age Furnishings and Equipment (26 TAC §746.2705)
violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver was caring for 6 school age children in the front office. The children were sitting on the floor, and playing with toys and cards.

violation_types.title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §744.1043)
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver's foreign education documents have not been translated into English verifying the education is equivalent to a US high school diploma.

violation_types.title: Written Activity Plans - Identify Groups and Plan Dates (26 TAC §744.2005(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: An activity plan for the week was not available for review.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Secure Supports (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child was sleeping in a crib with loose hardware. The child and mattress had sunken almost reaching the floor.

violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Conducted Local Sanitation Official (26 TAC §744.2501(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A current health inspection or letter indicating an inspection is not required was not available.

violation_types.title: Placement of Groups - Not Mingle Between Groups (26 TAC §744.1505(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Individual children were seen interacting freely among various groups, exiting the cafeteria, heading to the gym, departing from snack time, and joining a different group that was playing games. This was rectified during the inspection when the groups were established and the children stayed within their respective groups.

violation_types.title: AP Required Admission Information - Child able to swim competently (26 TAC §744.605(16)(A))
violation_types.typical_finding: The eight admission forms reviewed did not have information on whether or not each child was able to swim competently or had any conditions that would require them to be provided with a life jacket.

violation_types.title: Child Who Was Ill May Return to Care With Statement from Health-Care Professional That Child No Longer Ill (26 TAC §746.3606(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the preponderance of evidence it was determined the operation allowed a child who exhibited symptoms of illness, return to care and the operation did not obtain a physician's note.

violation_types.title: Initiating Background Checks as Specified in 26 TAC, Chapter 745, Subchapter F (26 TAC §742.307(1))

violation_types.title: Parental Notification of Safe Sleeping Deficiency (26 TAC §747.307(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Observed a blanket in the crib with an infant who was sleeping.    This was corrected when the blanket was removed.

violation_types.title: Written Activity Plans - Followed by Caregivers (26 TAC §744.2005(b)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The original activity plan that was posted was from February 2022. The activity plan was replaced with the current activity plan, however, staff did not follow the plan that was outlined for the day.

violation_types.title: Responsibilities - Provides access to all records (26 TAC §745.8411(b)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, video footage of the incident was accessible, but the childcare center did not provide it.

violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §744.3113(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: There is no monthly checklist available for review.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Drained Daily and Sanitized (26 TAC §747.4813(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: A wadding pool observed filled with water was observed in the children's play area.

violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Secure Each Child Appropriate System According to Manufacturers Instructions (26 TAC §747.5407(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: Children are transported without the proper use of car seats. The deficiency is related to a DFPS Abuse/Neglect investigation.
