violation_types.typical_finding: There was no documentation available stating orientation had been done for the caregivers.

violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §744.2401(i))
violation_types.typical_finding: It was found that a peanut m&m was served to a child with a diagnosed food allergy to peanuts.

violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys (26 TAC §747.2305(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is not equipped with a sufficient number of toys and equipment to keep the infant entertained.

violation_types.title: Nighttime Care - No More than 3 Consecutive 24-Hr Periods (Maximum 6 a Month) (26 TAC §746.3203(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the investigation conducted by DFPS, there is sufficient evidence to support that a child was left in care for more than three consecutive 24-hour periods.

violation_types.title: Specialized Medical Assistance - Provide as Recommended or Ordered by a Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §744.2665(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child enrolled at the operation has a food allergy, and an emergency food allergy plan on file, and this allergy requires an epi pen, however the operation does not have an epi pen for the child in their possession.     Operation given until 01/03/2022 to have epi pen on hand for the child due to the operation closing for Christmas break 12/17/2022-01/03/2022.

violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Swimming Activities - More Than 4 Children (Two or More Caregivers Required) (26 TAC §746.2105(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: A group of 22 5 year olds were in the pool, and there was only one qualified caregiver supervising. The pool was officially closed today, and the children returned to their classroom bringing the operation into compliance.

violation_types.title: Swimming Pools - Bottom Visible (26 TAC §746.5001(7))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection the pool was green where the bottom of the pool was not visible.

violation_types.title: Infant Care Area - Safe, Open Floor Space (26 TAC §747.2303(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Floor time is needed for the small infant in care.

violation_types.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption - Completed Child-care Career Program Approved by Home School & 24 Hrs. Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1109(a)(3)(B))
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver in the operation has not completed the completed hours of the required pre-service training.

violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Stored in Designated Location (26 TAC §746.4001(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was not available a first aid kit in a designated location in the center.

violation_types.title: Children Younger Than 5 - Policies - Duration of Physical Activity (26 TAC §744.2003(2)(B))
violation_types.typical_finding: The written operational policies was missing Duration of physical/outdoor activities.

violation_types.title: Parent right to file a complaint (26 TAC §744.521(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Documentation stating the parents right to file a complaint with Child Care and be tree from retaliatory action was missing from the operational policies.

violation_types.title: Immunizations-Immunization record must include the type of vaccine and number of doses (26 TAC §746.623(1)(B))
violation_types.typical_finding: Out of ten child files reviewed, one was missing three hepatitis B vaccinations and two IPV vaccinations. Another child file was missing a hepatitis B vaccination. A third child was missing the varicella vaccination.

violation_types.title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization (26 TAC §747.303(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The provider reported an incident involving a child who was transported to the hospital and received medical treatment five days after the incident occurred.

violation_types.title: AP Required Admission Information - Child able to swim competently (26 TAC §746.605(16)(A))
violation_types.typical_finding: CCR reviewed six children's admission files and found that the operation does not include a question on the form regarding whether a child can swim competently.

violation_types.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge (26 TAC §744.1013(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on internal documentation it has been determined that the caregivers present are unaware on who is left in charge at the operation during operating hours.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress (26 TAC §747.2309(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: A crib mattress had  rip  that exposed the foam filing. The rip is in the middle of the mattress, making it non-waterproof and non-washable.

violation_types.title: Heating Devices Safe - No Access By Children (26 TAC §747.5301(d))
violation_types.typical_finding: The space heater in the restroom did not have any safeguard and was not mounted to keep it from being accessible to children. This was corrected when the caregiver removed the space heater.

violation_types.title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §747.1213)
violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver's education document from a foreign country has not been translated into English to verify it is equivalent to a United States high school diploma.

violation_types.title: Children Younger Than 5 - Policies - Benefits (26 TAC §744.2003(2)(A))
violation_types.typical_finding: The written policies for physical/outdoor activities is missing describing benefits of activities.

violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Holding and Comforting (26 TAC §747.2301(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on an audio recording evaluated during the course of the investigation, it was determined that the provider did not comfort a child in care that was crying for over 5 minutes.

violation_types.title: HRC 42.049(a) - Operational Responsibilities- Maintain liability insurance coverage in the amount of $100,000 for each occurrence of negligence (26 TAC §HRC 42.049(a) - Operational Responsibili)
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was unable to provide proof of liability insurance.

violation_types.title: School-age Furnishings and Equipment - Age-appropriate Rest Equipment (26 TAC §747.2605(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was no mat observed for rest time.

violation_types.title: Free from other activities: Janitorial duties (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(4)(B))
violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver was seen cleaning (vacuuming)  her daycare space while the children were present; the children were playing freely as she performed her cleaning tasks. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was warned about this standard.

violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Only One Caregiver (26 TAC §747.2104(d))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the investigation children in care have not been spending time outdoors.

violation_types.title: Planned Activities- Children Requiring Special Care (26 TAC §747.2101(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child with special needs was seen at the operation sitting on the chair in the living room with no activities.

violation_types.title: Written Activity Plans - For Children in Care 5 or More Hours (26 TAC §744.2005(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was no written activity plans must caregivers follow to review during the monitoring inspection.

violation_types.title: Medication Authorization Expires on First Anniversary (26 TAC §747.3603(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: The signed medication authorization expired in 2023 and there was not an updated medication authorization on file for a child still receiving administered medication.

violation_types.title: Water Activities - Caregiver Must Be Present and Completed Water Safety Course or Lifeguard Required (26 TAC §742.807(e))
violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder allowed children to play in a wading pool and inflatable pool without completing an online water safety course beforehand.

violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Providing and Applying Insect Repellant and Sunscreen (26 TAC §744.501(16))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operational poiices were lacking information regarding insect repellant and sunscreen.

violation_types.title: Infant Handwashing - Raised to Sink (26 TAC §747.3217(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed not to have washed hands after a diaper change.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.

violation_types.title: Medication Records - Kept for 3 Months (26 TAC §744.2655(d))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was no medications log for the children that have medications on file at the time of inspection.

violation_types.title: Outdoor Activity Space Accessible By Safe Route or get required approval of plan (26 TAC §744.2959)
violation_types.typical_finding: A written plan was not submitted to CCR for the use of an indoor gym away from the operation.

violation_types.title: Location of Toilets (26 TAC §744.3007)
violation_types.typical_finding: The children in care were allowed to use the restrooms located outside under the pavilion.

violation_types.title: Caregiver Handwashing After Outdoor Activities (26 TAC §747.3211(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers did not wash their hands after coming into the home for outdoor activities.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Wading Pools - Stored Out of Children's Reach (26 TAC §747.4813(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: There is a wood sheet sitting on top of a gate and there is a turtle in the wading pool in the gate filled with water in the backyard where the children play.

violation_types.title: CO Detection System Connected to Alarm or Smoke Detection System- Installed According to State or Local Fire Marshal's Instructions (26 TAC §747.5335(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: This home was missing a carbon monoxide detector.

violation_types.title: Pre-service Training- Fostering Self-esteem (26 TAC §746.1305(a)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: Three caregivers did not receive Pre-Service Training in the area of Fostering Children's Self-esteem.

violation_types.title: Notification of Closure (26 TAC §746.301(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify Child Care Regulation before closing from August 1-18, 2025.

violation_types.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §747.701(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation it was found that the incident report did not have all required information documented.

violation_types.title: Space and Equipment - Age-appropriate Rest Equipment (26 TAC §744.2051(6))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the DFPS investigation, the children were sleeping on the floor.

violation_types.title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §747.2807(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, it was determined that a child in care was not able to nap and an alternate activity was not provided.

violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Proof of Notification about Deficencies in Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation as specified (26 TAC §746.801(22))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parents of a finding of abuse, neglect or exploitation using form 7266 with 5 days of notification from Licensing as required.

violation_types.title: Licensing may investigate any part of operation affecting health, safety, or well-being of children (26 TAC §745.8415)
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation denied interviews with children and access to children's files during a DFPS Investigation.

violation_types.title: Multiple Operations-Separate director for each (26 TAC §746.1005(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: The director is listed as director of 2 day care locations. There was not a designated director for another location. This was corrected during inspection when paperwork was completed and turned in for director designee.

violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation - Sanitize Equipment (26 TAC §747.3117(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: It was found that the food preparation area and equipment are not being sanitized as required.

violation_types.title: Meal and Snack Service - Adult Supervision (26 TAC §744.2421(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were not supervising appropriately to stop cross contamination.  Childdren were observed to be grabbing each others food, putting their feet on the table while eating, and the caregivers did not redirect the children.

violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Reasonable accommodations or modifications (26 TAC §747.605(13)(B)(i))
violation_types.typical_finding: Ten children records reviewed were missing information on reasonable accomodations or modifications during the inspection.

violation_types.title: Communication Between Center and Vehicle - Route, Times Known (26 TAC §746.5621(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, the operation staff were not able to provide documentation in order to verify the routine route, the departure time, and/or arrival time.

violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's name and telephone number must be clearly visible on the outside of the vehicle or kept inside the vehicle.

violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio for Field Trips (26 TAC §744.1701)
violation_types.typical_finding: There were 34 students and 4 teachers with the youngest child being 4 years old.

violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Potential complications (26 TAC §744.605(13)(B)(iii))
violation_types.typical_finding: Six out of six children records reviewed were missing symptoms or indications of potential complications related to a physical, cognitive, or mental condition that may warrant prevention or intervention while the child is in care.

violation_types.title: Use Zones - Licensed Before September 1, 2003 - Swings (26 TAC §746.4815(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was outdoor furniture in the back use zone of the swing set.

violation_types.title: Orientation Requirements for Caregivers-  Transportation Training (26 TAC §747.1301(15))
violation_types.typical_finding: I did not observe documentation of orientation for household members.

violation_types.title: Outdoor Space Requirements - At Least 25% of Indoor Capacity (26 TAC §746.4301(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have enough square footage in the outdoor activity space to equal at least 25% of the licensed indoor capacity.

violation_types.title: Parental Communication - Notify Immediately about Allegation of Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §747.305(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the parents were not informed of the incident that led to the DFPS investigation.

violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Harsh, Abusive or Profane Language (26 TAC §747.2705(7))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on an audio recording evaluated during the course of the investigation, it was determined that the provider used harsh language while children were in care.

violation_types.title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone number-Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline (1-800-252-5400) (26 TAC §744.405(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The document reviewed stated the abuse should be report to management and not the Abuse and Neglect line.

violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Minimum Standards (26 TAC §744.1203(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: It was found during an investigation that caregivers did not know how to write incident reports.

violation_types.title: HRC42.063(a)(3) - Reporting incidents and violations-an illness of a child that requires hospitalization (26 TAC §HRC42.063(a)(3) - Reporting incidents an)
violation_types.typical_finding: During a DFPS investigation, there was a child who was taken to the hospital due to a high fever. The operation failed to report the incident to childcare regulation.

violation_types.title: Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants (26 TAC §742.501(5))
violation_types.typical_finding: A 15 month old was observed wearing an Amber necklace. This was corrected at inspection as staff removed the necklace from the child.

violation_types.title: Able to Immediately Open Locked Doors (26 TAC §747.5011(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: The back door fire exit was blocked.

violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Prescribed medications; long term use (26 TAC §747.605(13)(C))
violation_types.typical_finding: 4 children's records did not have completed special care needs statements.

violation_types.title: Activities for School-age - Outdoor Play (26 TAC §746.2707(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The director stated that they have not been going outside since the summer.

violation_types.title: Nighttime Requirements - Visible Exits (26 TAC §747.3007(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Upon arriving inside of the home, the front exit pathway was not visible. Visibility of the exit pathways are pertinent to evaluate during an emergency.  The provider corrected the deficiency during the inspection by turning on lighting that allows the front exit pathway visible.

violation_types.title: Care Requirements 5 or More Hours - Supervised Naptimes or Rest Times (26 TAC §744.2002(7))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's activity plan did not include a rest period for the children. Noted: this was corrected during this inspection when the activity plan was updated to include a rest period.

violation_types.title: Caregiver Handwashing After Assisting a Child with Toileting (26 TAC §747.3211(5))
violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not wash her hands after changing a childs diaper.

violation_types.title: Doors to Restroom - Locks Out of Children's Reach (26 TAC §746.4421(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The restrooms in Preschool 1 and Preschool 2 classrooms had locks on the door handles that children could reach.

violation_types.title: Field Trips -First Aid Kit (26 TAC §746.3001(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: During a field trip to the park, the staff that were present did not have identifiable a shirt, nametag, or other identification listing the name of the child-care center and the child-care centers telephone number; not did the children have information that identified them to the center. Additionally, the first aid kit taken to the field trip was not complete as it was missing a thermometer. Lastly, the staff were observed not having physical items with information that list the children present and counting children.

violation_types.title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Height = Depth of Loose Fill (26 TAC §744.3251(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was using an 8ft rock climbing wall in a classroom without surfacing.

violation_types.title: Children Handwashing Before Playing in a Water Play Table (26 TAC §746.3417(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Children were observed playing in a water table without washing their hands beforehand.

violation_types.title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Notify Parent in Writing within 14 Days (26 TAC §747.213(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: There is not documentation showing parents have received written notification of the child care home not having liability insurance.

violation_types.title: Requirements for Bucket Swings (26 TAC §747.4503)
violation_types.typical_finding: An infant swing was on a short A frame and it was less than the required height.  The A frame was also not secured and moved easily when touched.

violation_types.title: Notify Employees of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.505(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not update their operational policy.

violation_types.title: May not record, listen to, or eavesdrop on any Licensing interview or internal discussion (26 TAC §745.8485(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information provided parts of interviews conducted with staff and children by licensing privately were listened to by management staff.

violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Tire Swings - All Directions (26 TAC §747.4609(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: The multi-axis swing did not have adequate space extending in all directions.

violation_types.title: Activities for School-age - Study Time (26 TAC §746.2707(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: I observed the after school children taken outdoors to the playground as soon as they are broughrt from school.  I asked the assistant director about this and she confirmed, they remain outdoors until their parent picks them up.

violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Meal and Snack Schedule (26 TAC §744.2403)
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have enough snacks for all children. Some children were provided with a snack only and some were not. The operation did not supply drinking water for the children who did receive a snack.

violation_types.title: Determining Child/Caregiver Ratios - All Children Included (26 TAC §747.1603(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: Operation was out of ratio on October 17th, 2024.

violation_types.title: Hand Sanitizer - Not Used on Visibly Soiled Hands Unless Away From Classroom and Soap & Water Not Available (26 TAC §747.3216(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Handwashing wasn't observed after cleaning a child's nose.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.

violation_types.title: Notify Caregivers of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §747.505(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Complete operational polices were not available at time of inspection.

violation_types.title: Parent right to file a complaint (26 TAC §747.521(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The parent rights were not included in the parent handbook.

violation_types.title: Communication Between Center and Vehicle - Have a Communication Device (26 TAC §746.5621(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient when a bus driver did not have a communication device to access the daycare available during the time of transport.

violation_types.title: Expectations for listed family home - Operate within the limits of its permit (26 TAC §745.8427(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the unannounced inspection, there were 6 unrelated children in care.      Three of the children left during the inspection correcting the deficiency.

violation_types.title: Special Diets - Discuss Eating Problems With Parents (26 TAC §746.3311(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A child that was enrolled in the after-school program did not want to eat breakfast or lunch that was offered to him.  This was not communicated to the parent until the following day.

violation_types.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Poisonous/Toxic Materials Stored Separate from Food (26 TAC §744.2419(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: Inspector observed children eating snack while sitting on the floor.

violation_types.title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §747.3903(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: During drop-off of children, the unknown person was not properly identified and recorded.

violation_types.title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs -Free Standing Arch Climbers (26 TAC §747.4405(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The home had a free standing arch climber in the outdoor space. This was corrected at inspection when the provider removed the free standing arch climber during the inspection.

violation_types.title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Use Praise and Encouragement (26 TAC §744.2103(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: There is a violation to this standard

violation_types.title: Private Water Supply Meets Requirements of TCEQ (26 TAC §746.3431(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated and compliance was not met. The operation does not have written records from the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality stating the water supply meets their requirements.

violation_types.title: Electric or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Install new Battery in Each CO Detector Annually (26 TAC §744.3757(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: I received a text from Director Mark Ajuzie showing the carbon monoxide detector working with a new battery.

violation_types.title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs -Free Standing Arch Climbers (26 TAC §744.3107(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Four children stated they play on the free standing arch climber while they are at the YMCA afterschool program.

violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - 4 - 7 Years; 4 Feet, 9 Inches and Taller (26 TAC §746.5607(d)(6))
violation_types.typical_finding: The transportation vehicle does not have a required booster seat for child that was tranported on this day and  requires this type of equipment.

violation_types.title: Administering Medication - As Amended in Writing by Child's Health Care Professional (26 TAC §747.3605(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The provider did not have the required medication per the child's food allergy plan.

violation_types.title: Training Criteria - Learning Objectives (26 TAC §746.1317(c)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The Pre-Service training certificates do not state learning objectives for 5 out of 10 staff records evaluated.

violation_types.title: Documentation for Primary Caregivers of Licensed Home - Personal History Statement (26 TAC §747.1131(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The primary caregiver did not have proof of drivers license in the file at inspection. This was corrected at inspection.

violation_types.title: Director Responsibilities - Employee Assignments (26 TAC §744.1005(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The program director assigned a caregiver to a location without all required new hire training to be left alone with children. In addition, the caregiver was not provided a key to access the program's first aid kit and a list of the children in care.

violation_types.title: 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height or cannot be properly secured (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(4)(C))
violation_types.typical_finding: Bus used to transport children ages 5-11yo is missing safety belts.

violation_types.title: Household Members Comply with Minimum Standard Rules (26 TAC §747.207(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The person left in charge is not familiar with minimum standards and does not qualify as a substitute.

violation_types.title: Documentation for Directors - Submit with New Application (26 TAC §744.1037(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify licensing of change of site director.     The caregiver was present during the inspection. There were no director credentials on file.

violation_types.title: Administering Medication - As Amended in Writing by Child's Health Care Professional (26 TAC §744.2655(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the proper medication in care for the child who requires an EpiPen.

violation_types.title: Additional Requirements For Outdoor Activity Space Not Connected To Operation - Written Plan for Supervision (26 TAC §744.2961(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a written plan explaining how they plan to supervise the children while playing and traveling to the outdoor activity space that is not connected to the operation.

violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Potential complications (26 TAC §747.605(13)(B)(iii))
violation_types.typical_finding: Ten children files reviewed were missing information on symptoms or indications of potential complications related to a physical, cognitive, or mental condition that may warrant prevention or intervention while child is in care during inspection.

violation_types.title: 4 through 7 years of age, outgrown weight or height limit of seat and less than 4 feet, 9 inches in height or cannot be properly secured (26 TAC §744.3807(e)(3)(A))
violation_types.typical_finding: Four 7 year old children, under the height of 4'9", rode the general purpose vehicle without the use of a booster seat.

violation_types.title: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure (26 TAC §747.4501(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: There is a composite play structure at the operation.     This was corrected at inspection when the provider stated that this structure will no longer be used by children in care.

violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Licensed Child Care Home with 3 or More Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1805)
violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of inspection there were eleven children in care.  Three of the children were ages 12 months to 15 months, making the ratio for one caregiver to have a total of seven children in care.

violation_types.title: Field Trips - Caregivers Easily Identifiable (26 TAC §747.2901(a)(7))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was on a field trip and did not have a way to identify herself.

violation_types.title: Driver Has Current Driver's License and Carries While Transporting Children (26 TAC §744.3817(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have documentation of a current drivers license on file for one driver.

violation_types.title: Requirements for Tire Swings - Minimum Clearance (26 TAC §747.4505(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has a tire swing that does not meet the minimum clearance.

violation_types.title: Field Trips - Ensure Safety (26 TAC §744.2301)

violation_types.typical_finding: A silver nail bolt was sticking out of the black barrier on the playground.

violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Accommodations or modifications (26 TAC §744.605(13)(B)(i))
violation_types.typical_finding: Six out of six children files reviewed were missing reasonable accomodations and modifications information.

violation_types.title: Care Requirements 5 or More Hours - Active and Quiet Play (26 TAC §744.2002(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection the pre-school classrooms was found to not have adequate amount of age appropriate activities for the children.

violation_types.title: Share Toilets and Sinks - Have Written Plan (26 TAC §744.3015(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation shares restrooms with children who  do open gym.

violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Engage in Outdoor and Active Play if more than One Caregiver (26 TAC §747.2104(c)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The children are not able to utilize the backyard for outdoor play, and are primarily playing indoors.

violation_types.title: Specialized Medical Assistance - Maintain Written Recommendations or Orders in Child's File for 3 Months (26 TAC §744.2665(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: One child, with a prescribed inhaler, was missing the asthma action plan.

violation_types.title: Additional Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know and Comply with Minimum Standards (26 TAC §747.1501(c)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has been cited for child to caregiver ratio three times.

violation_types.title: Training Requirements for substitutes, volunteers, and contractors - Water Safety training (26 TAC §746.1403(a)(7)(A))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was no water safety training for employees available during the inspection time.

violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Field Trip Permission (26 TAC §747.605(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: Parent's permission for field trips was missing in two of the children's records reviewed.

violation_types.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Adhesive Bandages (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: The thermometer from the first aid kit in the transportation vehicle was missing.      Note: The thermometer was placed in the first aid kit during the inspection.

violation_types.title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §744.2601(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: Two a/c units on the playground did not have a safeguard to prevent children access.

violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Potential complications (26 TAC §746.605(12)(B)(iii))
violation_types.typical_finding: This was evaluated as part of a DFPS investigation and found deficient.     Based on information provided in the investigation, it was found that a child had a known history of specific injury and no documentation with instructions of signs or symptoms to look for if the injury were to occur again.

violation_types.title: Records Storage - Training Records Current and Last Year (26 TAC §747.803(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: The provider had only 15 hours of annual training for the training year 20219/2020 and none of for the 2020/2021 training year.  This includes none of  the required topics.

violation_types.title: No Alcohol or Controlled Substances Consumed (26 TAC §747.3503(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: An ash tray was found in the home with ashes inside of it. The ashes and tray smelled of marijuana.

violation_types.title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 4 Yrs- Horizontal Ladders (26 TAC §746.4605(b)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Children 3 years old were observed playing on horizontal ladders. They are also playing on the parallel bars.

violation_types.title: Field Trips-Caregiver must have Pediatric CPR and Pediatric First Aid (26 TAC §744.2301(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: Staff hired on 6/13/2022 and 10/23/2017 do not have vaild CPR training. Operation is going on a field trip.

violation_types.title: Required posting of Emergency Telephone numbers-Poison Control Phone Number (26 TAC §747.403(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: During review the phone numbers posted did not have the poison control number.

violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Combining Infants with Older Children in Get-well Care (26 TAC §746.1905)
violation_types.typical_finding: Infants were combined with older children. They were separated when one caregiver arrived.

violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Caregiver-initiated Activities (26 TAC §746.2206(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: The activity plans were missing caregiver centered movement activities.

violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Stored in Designated Location (26 TAC §744.2751(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: There was no marked and desginated place for a complete first aid kit, clearly marked and known for caregivers.

violation_types.title: Documentation for Directors - Submit When New Director Designated (26 TAC §746.1039(b)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not submitted documentation to Child Care Regulation showing that the director meets the minimum qualifications

violation_types.title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Curbside (26 TAC §746.5605(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver allowed children to run across a parking lot when they were unloaded from the transportation van.

violation_types.title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed (26 TAC §744.3807(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: I observed the transportation vehicle without a car seat for a child that was transported by operation on today.

violation_types.title: Window as a Fire Exit (26 TAC §747.5013)
violation_types.typical_finding: The window used as an emergency exit does not open.

violation_types.title: Doors to Restroom -Able to Open Immediately (26 TAC §747.4211(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The restroom that will be utalized by childen has a door knob that locks and is accessible to children.

violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Allow Children to Progress at Developmental Rate (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The chilldren were observed sitting at the table for 2 hours with blocks during the inspection.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs and Play Yards - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §742.503(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: An infant younger than 12 months was observed sleeping in a play yard with a blanket and a bottle.

violation_types.title: Animals at Home - Animals with Behavioral Changes (26 TAC §747.3705(c)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information gathered during the investigation, the household dog bit a child in care during outside activity time.

violation_types.title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Set Up During Other Activities (26 TAC §747.2809(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: During inspection the nap mats were set up prior to nap time and before lunch time.

violation_types.title: Use of Equipment Fundamental for Skill - Follow Manufacturer's Guidelines (26 TAC §744.3105(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Swinging rings and trampolines must be used according to manufacturers instructions.

violation_types.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Accessible to Children (26 TAC §747.2505(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: No shelf or containers to storage supplies were observed.

violation_types.title: Maximum Height of Play Surface - Licensed Before Sept. 1 2010 -  Under 5 Years (26 TAC §746.4609(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The two playgrounds do not have 6 inches of mulch for surfacing.

violation_types.title: Use of Equipment Fundamental for Skill - Follow Manufacturer's Guidelines (26 TAC §744.3107(c)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: A four year old child was playing on equipment for children five and over.

violation_types.title: Operation Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §744.2507(8))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during investigation, it was determined the air conditioner was not operating properly at the previous location.

violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Secure Supports (26 TAC §747.2309(a)(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: A crib for the infant in care was observed being modified with one side missing leading to unsafe sleeping for the infant in care.

violation_types.title: Installation of Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §744.3617)
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have smoke detectors.  Note: They are not currently required by the fire marshal as the building is grandfathered in.

violation_types.title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact Parent (26 TAC §746.3605(b)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: The daycare failed to notify the parent immediately after a child in care experienced a medical emergency that required medical treatment and subsequently hospitalization.

violation_types.title: Activities for Toddlers - Provide Language Development (26 TAC §747.2407(6))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a variety of books for all ages of children.

violation_types.title: Liability Insurance Requirements - If No Insurance Then Must Provide Written Proof Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §744.205(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: Operation has not provided proof of annual verification for insurance.

violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment Including Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §742.603(a))
violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver threatened a child with corporal punishment if they moved from the couch.

violation_types.title: Report Unsafe Facility Occurrence (26 TAC §744.305(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: It wasn't reported to Licensing that the operation sustained damage to the camp's primary space of the gym during the last major storm rendering it unsafe for use.

violation_types.title: Policies for Release of Children Instruct Employees of Verification Plan (26 TAC §744.2803(c))
violation_types.typical_finding: The staff have not been trained on how to properly identify and release children.

violation_types.title: School-age - Interest Centers Used Independently (26 TAC §747.2603(1)(A))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have age appropriate equipment for school age children.

violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Tire Swings - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4809(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: A multi-axis swing didn't have large enough use zones around it. The swing was removed during the inspection.

violation_types.title: Storage of Medication - Not Contaminate Food (26 TAC §746.3807(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver's medication was stored on a shelf along with the infant belongings and infant formula. the shelf was directglry above the sink.

violation_types.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Not in Charge of Group (26 TAC §747.1211(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained by a CCI investigator, there was a 16 year child present and caring for a child alone while the primary caregiver was absent from the home.

violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Inspection not available, you must obtain documentation stating inspection not available (26 TAC §744.2501(c)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current copy of the sanitation inspection available for review.

violation_types.title: AP Report a Child In Care Showing Signs and Symptoms of Illness Requiring Hospitalization (26 TAC §744.305(a)(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the investigation findings this standard was reviewed and found to be in non-compliance. An incident occurred where a child required hospitalization on 06/07/2023. The incident was not reported to Child Care Regulation (CCR) timely; the incident was reported to CCR on 06/15/2023.

violation_types.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Responsible for Snack if Parent Does Not Provide (26 TAC §746.3309(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: USDA requires snacks to include two meal components out of five (milk, grains, vegetables, fruits, and meat).  Center is providing one component for snack.

violation_types.title: Indoor Useable Space (26 TAC §747.4005)
violation_types.typical_finding: During inspection in the day care main room, the operation had limited open space for group activities. The area was crowded with  learning and playing equipment leaving no open space for children to move around freely. Photos taken.    This was corrected at inspection after several pieces of equipment were removed from the area to free up space for children. Photos taken.

violation_types.title: Activities for School-age - Provide Indoor and Outdoor Active Play (26 TAC §746.2707(6))
violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple children between the ages of 4yr-12yr were observed playing on their cellphones during the inspection.     Note: The caregiver prompted the children to put away their cellphones.

violation_types.title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Date (26 TAC §744.1331(b)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The operation could not provide CCR with a copy of the caregiver?s CPR and First Aid certificate or any documentation confirming completion of the required training.

violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing Before Feeding a Child (26 TAC §744.2515(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Caregiver did not wash their hands before serving children pizza, caregiver only place gloves on their hands.

violation_types.title: CO Detection System Connected to Alarm or Smoke Detection System- Test Documentation Available During Hours of Operation (26 TAC §747.5337(b)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: The provider is not testing the carbon monoxide detection system monthly.

violation_types.title: Nighttime Requirements - Crib for Infants (26 TAC §746.3207(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: Four infants were not on their cribs but on another sleeping equipment.

violation_types.title: Required posting of name, address, and telephone number - Local CCR office (26 TAC §746.405(b)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency telephone number posting included the incorrect telephone number for the local Child Care Regulation Office. This was corrected at inspection.

violation_types.title: Protective Barriers Around Porches or Platforms (26 TAC §744.3101(a)(9))
violation_types.typical_finding: The platforms such as the warp wall must have a fence around the platform.

violation_types.title: Personnel Records - TB Test (26 TAC §747.901(3))
violation_types.typical_finding: 2 out of 2 caregivers did not have a TB on file.

violation_types.title: 4 through 7 years, outgrown weight or height limit; can be properly secured by vehicle safety belt and is 4 feet 9 inches in height or taller (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(5)(A))
violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers are not checking all of the seatbelts to ensure they are tightened enough to prevent children from falling out of their seats.

violation_types.title: Critical Injury - Contact EMS After Ensuring Supervision of Group (26 TAC §744.2577(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation, it was found that the operation called the parent but not EMS when a child received a head injury requiring stitches after falling from a basketball hoop.

violation_types.title: Transportation Child/Caregiver Ratio - Children 2 Years and Older (26 TAC §746.1805(b))
violation_types.typical_finding: Caregiver who provides transportation does not meet caregiver qualifications.

violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child (26 TAC §747.3303(c)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver was observed changing a child's diaper and did not have hands securing the child. The caregiver was observed walking away from the child leaving the child on the changing table.

violation_types.title: Administering Medication - According to Label Directions (26 TAC §744.2655(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, the staff have not been administering medication to children according to the label directions.

violation_types.title: Documented annual training - Each child care center director if allow child access to swimming pool (26 TAC §746.1325(a)(2))
violation_types.typical_finding: Two staff did not have water safety training. It was corrected when they completed the training during the inspection.

violation_types.title: Infant Care Area - Space to Walk Between Cribs, Cots or Mats (26 TAC §747.2303(4))
violation_types.typical_finding: The cots were arranged for naptime; however, there was no space between them, preventing the caregiver from walking between the cots.

violation_types.title: Toddler Care Area - Allow Individual and Group Times (26 TAC §746.2503(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: Observed that two classrooms were not set up for children to use.

violation_types.title: Required Posting of Emergency Telephone numbers-911 (26 TAC §744.405(a)(1))
violation_types.typical_finding: The required Emergency Phone Numbers were not posted at the time of inspection.

violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Field Trips (26 TAC §744.501(14))
violation_types.typical_finding: The parent handbook does not include information regarding the operations field trip policy.
